scope: V7 unified vLLM 0.20.1 weight-only persistent Store fixed chain; CPU KV persistence excluded
random_design: Randomized Euler circuit of the directed three-model multigraph: every distinct directed edge exactly twice; no self transitions
timing_scope: Host activation marker to parsed complete correct first historical business response; first output kept separately in backend events; not pure weight loading
cache_policy: Natural Store eviction; no ClearMem/drop_caches/manual unload/preload. Initial empty Store; random phase inherits the proved full Kimi residency after fixed step5.
jit_policy: Reuse separate per-model copies of the completed full-v4 JIT caches; fresh GPU backend/engine each request.
release_policy: At least60 seconds empty-Store baseline, between every model teardown with only common Store GPU processes, and final all-GPU zero release.
failure_policy: Stop next model immediately on any failed gate, preserve originals and isolate own containers; no silent reruns
booking_basis: Direct GPU use explicitly authorized by user; actual occupancy checked; no reservation required.
random_initialization_source: Final Kimi activation of the fixed chain, recorded separately and not counted as a random switch
supersedes: The five-step chain of v7-store-20261110T054033Z passed Kimi and stopped at 01-fixed-glm: the historical GLM payload is the raw pre-postprocess state of vLLM 0.19.1.dev1 and is not a 0.20.1 constructor schema. v7-glm-rebuild-20261110T113709Z rebuilt that raw state under the pinned 0.20.1 image into /data/brick3/boyjiang/glm5.1-fp8-store-v7-target-0201-20261110-v3; this protocol points at that payload. Historical payload and its failures remain. v7-store-20261110T122351Z then passed 00-fixed-kimi (617,000,763,392 read bytes, 18392 blocks, full_miss) and failed 01-fixed-glm inside the loader because the backend config carried no model_loader_extra_config identity, so the loader applied the historical 0.19.1 schema check. This protocol passes the frozen identity to the loader.
os_file_cache: natural state; Store-cold is not physical SSD-cold
software_identity: Original V4 image digest plus immutable source and entrypoint overlays; no new inference environment
sleep_baseline: Independent native SafeTensors load; same worker Sleep L1/Wake; own Store shut down first; separate memory observer and final >=60sec release required
